option.default_off: absent/None/False = old behaviour byte-identical (no new summary keys, no new reads)

rule.imitation_admission: aggregate gate (every replicate advantage > 0: first seed + confirmation replication) AND significance: paired per-vehicle road-speed-deficit differences (policy vs chosen plan) from the recorded observable.jsonl.gz traces, pooled across the replicate seeds, one-sided 95% bootstrap lower bound of the mean > 0 (10000 resamples, 5th percentile, numpy default_rng(20261101)); documented fallback when no traces are readable: the bound over the >= 2 replicate aggregates must be > 0
rule.deficit_integrand: the plant's own registered speed deficit max(0, 1 - v_mps/SPEED_LIMIT_MPS) per vehicle-second (traffic_shepherd.c4.env SPEED_LIMIT_MPS=31.29); paired per vehicle over seconds both traces record; missing traces degrade to the aggregate rule, never imputed
rule.cooperative_label: group-minus-best-solo paired per-vehicle bound > 0 on the first seed (fallback: recorded aggregate gain > 0), plus the group-minus-sum-of-solos synergy C_G > 0 where all solos completed (C_G has no physical branch, so its requirement is the recorded aggregate; disclosed)
rule.reporting: kept/dropped entries with reason, bound, n_paired, replicate aggregates and cooperative old/new under summary['bank_filter']; 50% cooperative oversampling applies to the filtered cooperative set, weights unchanged
rule.thresholds: statistical rules only; no hand-set behavioural thresholds
